SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM onsetDateTime) AS diagnosis_year, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count
            FROM condition
            WHERE code = '307426000' AND system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND onsetDateTime IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY diagnosis_year
            ORDER BY diagnosis_year

SELECT p.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY p.gender

SELECT AVG(enc_count) AS avg_encounters_per_patient
            FROM (
                SELECT c.patient_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS enc_count
                FROM condition c
                LEFT JOIN encounter e ON c.patient_id = e.patient_id
                WHERE c.code = 'K03.81' AND c.system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10'
                GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ) sub

description: average number of encounters per patient among those diagnosed with a given condition

sql:

            FROM (
                SELECT c.patient_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS enc_count
                FROM condition c
                LEFT JOIN encounter e ON c.patient_id = e.patient_id
                WHERE c.code = 'D16.4' AND c.system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10'
                GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ) sub

description: for each patient, the change in a given observation's value between their first and most recent recorded reading
display: Leukocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
                SELECT patient_id, valueQuantity, effectiveDateTime,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime ASC, id ASC) AS rn_first,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime DESC, id ASC) AS rn_last
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '6690-2' AND system = 'http://loinc.org' AND valueQuantity IS NOT NULL
            )
            SELECT f.patient_id, f.valueQuantity AS first_value, l.valueQuantity AS last_value,
                   l.valueQuantity - f.valueQuantity AS delta
            FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1) f
            JOIN (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_last = 1) l ON f.patient_id = l.patient_id
            WHERE f.patient_id != l.patient_id OR f.effectiveDateTime != l.effectiveDateTime

                SELECT patient_id, valueQuantity, effectiveDateTime,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime ASC, id ASC) AS rn_first,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime DESC, id ASC) AS rn_last
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '2502-3' AND system = 'http://loinc.org' AND valueQuantity IS NOT NULL
            )
            SELECT f.patient_id, f.valueQuantity AS first_value, l.valueQuantity AS last_value,
                   l.valueQuantity - f.valueQuantity AS delta
            FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1) f
            JOIN (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_last = 1) l ON f.patient_id = l.patient_id
            WHERE f.patient_id != l.patient_id OR f.effectiveDateTime != l.effectiveDateTime

sql:
SELECT AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', c.onsetDateTime, m.first_rx)) AS avg_days_to_treatment
            FROM condition c
            JOIN (
                SELECT patient_id, MIN(authoredOn) AS first_rx
                FROM medication_request
                WHERE code = '314076' AND system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
                GROUP BY patient_id
            ) m ON c.patient_id = m.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND m.first_rx >= c.onsetDateTime

                SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM effectiveDateTime) AS yr, ROUND(AVG(valueQuantity), 4) AS avg_val
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '25428-4' AND system = 'http://loinc.org' AND effectiveDateTime IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY yr
            )
            SELECT yr, avg_val, avg_val - LAG(avg_val) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS yoy_delta
            FROM yearly
            ORDER BY yr

description: for each patient, their age at first diagnosis of a given condition, oldest 5 shown
sql:
SELECT c.patient_id, MIN(DATE_DIFF('year', p.birthDate, c.onsetDateTime)) AS age_at_first_diagnosis
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ORDER BY age_at_first_diagnosis DESC, c.patient_id
            LIMIT 5

SELECT c.patient_id, MIN(DATE_DIFF('year', p.birthDate, c.onsetDateTime)) AS age_at_first_diagnosis
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE c.code = '70704007' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ORDER BY age_at_first_diagnosis DESC, c.patient_id
            LIMIT 5

SELECT c.patient_id, MIN(DATE_DIFF('year', p.birthDate, c.onsetDateTime)) AS age_at_first_diagnosis
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE c.code = 'K04.8' AND c.system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10'
            GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ORDER BY age_at_first_diagnosis DESC, c.patient_id
            LIMIT 5
